description: Source code for the 'Journal Entry' doctype in ERPNext, including class definitions, validation, and utility functions related to accounting journal entries.

classes.name: StockAccountInvalidTransaction
classes.description: ValidationError class for invalid stock account transactions.

classes.name: JournalEntry
classes.description: Main class representing a Journal Entry, with methods for validation, posting, canceling, and related operations.

methods.name: get_default_bank_cash_account
methods.description: Fetches default bank or cash account details for a given company and account type.

methods.name: get_payment_entry_against_order
methods.description: Creates a payment entry against a sales or purchase order.

methods.name: get_payment_entry_against_invoice
methods.description: Creates a payment entry against a sales or purchase invoice.

methods.name: get_payment_entry
methods.description: Constructs a Journal Entry object for a payment, including bank and party details.

methods.name: get_opening_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves all balance sheet accounts for opening entry for a given company.

methods.name: get_against_jv
methods.description: Searches for Journal Entries that match given account and party filters.

methods.name: get_outstanding
methods.description: Calculates outstanding amount for a given document, such as Journal Entry, Sales Invoice, or Purchase Invoice.

methods.name: get_party_account_and_balance
methods.description: Returns account, balance, and party balance for a given party.

methods.name: get_account_balance_and_party_type
methods.description: Returns account balance and party type for a selected account, used in Journal Entry.

methods.name: make_inter_company_journal_entry
methods.description: Creates a new inter-company Journal Entry.

methods.name: make_reverse_journal_entry
methods.description: Creates a reversed copy of an existing Journal Entry.
